prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a professional landscape character model sheet for the approved mascot. Preserve the approved Brundlefly identity from the character reference: gross adult mid-mutation human-fly, hunched lanky build, exactly FOUR ARMS (two long shoulder arms and two smaller arms emerging at the lower ribs) and TWO LEGS, exactly TWO uneven developing wings, ridged rusty pink-brown folded flesh, dark chitin, blue-black eyes with tiny cold teal highlights, sparse bristles, long drooping mouth folds and short mouth appendages. Crisp blocky pixel art, hard square pixels without smooth gradients, Terraria-like sprite rendering. No cute proportions, orange eyes, clothes, gore spray or exposed organs. No extra limbs. Reference image is the canonical design, not a loose mood reference. Near-black neutral background. Top row: three equal-scale full-body turnaround views, front, left profile, back, arranged cleanly with generous spacing. The back view must show wing attachments and all three limb-pair attachment levels. Bottom row: enlarged head close-up, separate hand-to-claw detail, and small wing detail. Consistent anatomy, color, scale and mutation stage across all views. Clear countable limbs on front and back; naturally occluded limbs in profile. No labels, title, text, numbers, arrows or logos whatsoever. No alternative character concepts, expressions or stages.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create a square 1024 by 1024 GitHub avatar artwork from the canonical character reference. Preserve the approved Brundlefly identity from the character reference: gross adult mid-mutation human-fly, hunched lanky build, exactly FOUR ARMS (two long shoulder arms and two smaller arms emerging at the lower ribs) and TWO LEGS, exactly TWO uneven developing wings, ridged rusty pink-brown folded flesh, dark chitin, blue-black eyes with tiny cold teal highlights, sparse bristles, long drooping mouth folds and short mouth appendages. Crisp blocky pixel art, hard square pixels without smooth gradients, Terraria-like sprite rendering. No cute proportions, orange eyes, clothes, gore spray or exposed organs. No extra limbs. Head and upper shoulders only, face centered and mostly frontal with slight three-quarter asymmetry. The enlarged head fills about 70 percent of the square. Both dark teal eye glints, central flesh ridge and drooping mouth folds must remain readable at 32 pixels. Simplify tiny flesh detail into bold pixel clusters while retaining repulsive folded face and narrow unsettling eyes. Sparse bristle silhouette, subtle wing roots behind shoulders only, no full-body miniature. Keep important facial features within the central 70 percent circular safe area. Solid near-black background, strong rust face contrast, no circular border, no frame, no letters, no text, no slogans.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a wide GitHub repository banner and social-preview artwork, exactly 2:1 aspect ratio, intended final export 1280 by 640 pixels. First reference is the canonical new mascot; second reference supplies approved wordmark typography and overall dark branding treatment only. Replace the old mascot completely with the canonical rusty fleshy six-limbed new mascot. Preserve the approved Brundlefly identity from the character reference: gross adult mid-mutation human-fly, hunched lanky build, exactly FOUR ARMS (two long shoulder arms and two smaller arms emerging at the lower ribs) and TWO LEGS, exactly TWO uneven developing wings, ridged rusty pink-brown folded flesh, dark chitin, blue-black eyes with tiny cold teal highlights, sparse bristles, long drooping mouth folds and short mouth appendages. Crisp blocky pixel art, hard square pixels without smooth gradients, Terraria-like sprite rendering. No cute proportions, orange eyes, clothes, gore spray or exposed organs. No extra limbs. Layout: distressed condensed cream uppercase wordmark on the left, full-body canonical mascot crouched on the right with all limbs inside margins, fine restrained olive biological vein texture only along outer corners on a near-black background. Keep center clean with strong contrast. Typography should match approved tall heavy condensed industrial horror wordmark, subtle distressed erosion and torn vertical notch, highly readable. Exact and ONLY text: BRUNDLEFLY. Spell B R U N D L E F L Y. No tagline, subtitle, footer, symbols, UI, labels, decorative text or watermark. Both mascot and wordmark have 7 percent safe outer margins. Premium sparse composition consistent with approved brand, no bright orange eyes or old laboratory coat.
